name: ULTRAKILL
creator: New Blood Interactive
desc: I really love ULTRAKILL, I got it around December of 2025 and I was instantly hooked, the main thing i love about it is the themings behind the game, ULTRAKILL and a lot of other media is based off the Diving Comedy - Dante's Inferno, which dictates the journey of Dante and his guide Vergil into the 9 layers of hell etc. ULTRAKILL flawlessly integrates a lot of the mythology into its game but twists it in its own way in such a perfect way. After playing it I really wanted to add my own interpretation to such media, So i made Inflerna which is now my largest project to date where i integrate Dante's Inferno in my own way, Another part of ULTRAKILL i love and am now integrating into my own media is the integration of a story driven loop and heavy replayability, because you first progress through ULTRAKILL's story but you can 'P' rank levels which means getting them perfect which adds hundreds of hours of replayability, and I also plan to use story driven + replayable mechanics in Inflerna

name: Library of Ruina
creator: Project Moon
desc: Library of Ruina is  such a cool game, my friend got me into it a few months ago and this game completely reshaped how i view deckbuilders, because unlike your typical deckbuilder, Project Moon created a riveting story based game where you customise 'Librarians' with Key pages that dictate their attributes like health speed etc. As well as that you can apply attack pages to them to further customise the moves they can use, these combinations of customisability allow for some insane builds and combos to be created. From this ive basically stolen the base ideas of it and changed to combat to be in my own light for Inflerna where flowers can be equiped with deeds and those deeds can have attack pages. As well as the deckbuilding, Library of Ruina has some insane writing and worldbuilding, and the techniques that are used I will be reviewing and 'Politely snatching' for enhancing my own storytelling inside of Inflerna
